task.title: Ko‘paytirish jadvali, juftlar yig‘indisi va unlilar
task.description: Platforma n sonini va word so‘zini beradi. 1) for sikli bilan n uchun ko‘paytirish jadvalining 10 ta qatorini "5 x 1 = 5" … "5 x 10 = 50" ko‘rinishida chiqaring (shablon satr bilan). 2) let evenSum da 1 dan n gacha (u ham kiradi) juft sonlar yig‘indisini hisoblang. 3) let vowelCount da word dagi a, e, i, o, u unlilarini for...of sikli bilan registrni hisobga olmay sanang.

tests.name: 5 uchun jadval: "5 x 1 = 5" dan "5 x 10 = 50" gacha 10 qator
tests.check: (() => { const rows = __logs.filter((l) => /^\d+ x \d+ = \d+$/.test(l)); return rows.length === 10 && rows.every((l, idx) => l === `5 x ${idx + 1} = ${5 * (idx + 1)}`); })()
tests.fail: Aynan 10 ta `${n} x ${i} = ${n * i}` qatori kerak - x va = atrofida bo‘sh joy.

tests.name: 7 uchun jadval
tests.check: (() => { const rows = __logs.filter((l) => /^\d+ x \d+ = \d+$/.test(l)); return rows.length === 10 && rows.every((l, idx) => l === `7 x ${idx + 1} = ${7 * (idx + 1)}`); })()

tests.name: n = 5: evenSum = 6 (2 + 4)
tests.fail: To‘plovchi: sikldan oldin let evenSum = 0;, juft i uchun evenSum += i;.

tests.name: n = 10: evenSum = 30
tests.fail: n ni oraliqqa kiriting: i <= n.

tests.name: n = 1: evenSum = 0
tests.fail: 1 dan 1 gacha juft son yo‘q - yig‘indi 0.

tests.name: "JavaScript": 3 ta unli
tests.fail: Hisoblagich: sikldan oldin let vowelCount = 0;, unlilar uchun vowelCount++;.

tests.name: "rhythm": 0 ta unli
tests.fail: Bu topshiriqda y unli emas; unlisiz so‘zda hisoblagich 0.

tests.name: for sikli ishlatilgan
tests.fail: Jadval va yig‘indini for (let i = 1; ...) sikli bilan hisoblang.

tests.name: Dastur xatosiz tugaydi
tests.fail: Xato yoki cheksiz sikl: sikl sharti qachondir false bo‘lishini tekshiring.

hints: Jadval: for (let i = 1; i <= 10; i++) { console.log(`${n} x ${i} = ${n * i}`); }
To‘plovchi va hisoblagichni sikldan OLDIN let bilan e’lon qiling.
So‘zni aylanib chiqish: for (const char of word) { ... }

questions.question: for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) sikli tanasi necha marta bajariladi? Sonni kiriting.
for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) da shart qachon tekshiriladi?
Nima chiqadi: let sum = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) { sum += i; } console.log(sum);
Nima uchun bu sikl cheksiz: let i = 1; while (i <= 5) { console.log(i); }
options: while ni sonlar bilan ishlatib bo‘lmaydi

questions.question: for (const char of "non") siklida char ga nima tushadi?
options: n, o, n belgilari navbat bilan

questions.question: let total = 0; to‘plovchisi qayerda e’lon qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Sikl ichida u har iteratsiyada nolga tushardi.

questions.question: Vazifani mos sikl bilan moslashtiring.
questions.explanation: Sikl tanlovi qadamlar soni ma’lum yoki yo‘qligiga bog‘liq.

questions.question: Nima chiqadi: let s = ""; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { s += "*"; } console.log(s);
Qaysi sonlar chiqadi: for (let i = 1; i <= 6; i++) { if (i % 3 === 0) { continue; } console.log(i); }
questions.explanation: 3 va 6 o‘tkazib yuboriladi; 5 ham chiqadi, lekin u variantlarda yo‘q.

questions.question: Cheksiz siklda platforma qaysi xatoni ko‘rsatadi?
